prerequisites: Depending on the task: Basic engineering knowledge from Technical Mechanics, Electrical Engineering/Electronics, Computer Science, Machine Elements.
Product Development (FZT/MEC) or Design Theory 1 (MAB) course.

learning_outcomes.text: Students learn to independently and holistically process an innovative task from a scientific or technical/constructive environment in a working group, prepare the results in a technical-scientific documentation, and present them to a professional audience with a final presentation.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of the task, specification of requirements in consultation with the supervisor
Time and, if applicable, cost planning for all relevant project contents, definition of suitable milestones
Systematic and timely processing of all necessary work packages with correct application of professionally appropriate methods
Upon reaching milestones, preparation and presentation of interim results to the supervisor and logging of important project-related decisions
Elaboration of a written technical-scientific documentation of the work results, presentation and defense of the project contents and results before a professional audience
assessment_rules: Student knowledge is assessed based on their project work (PA/1S), a written elaboration (study performance), a 20-minute project presentation, and a subsequent 20-minute oral examination.
bibliography: Technical literature from all technical fields
